hint: Let another device on your network (or a future OpenPal mobile app) use this computer as its inference source. Off by default.
enableLabel: Allow other devices to use this computer

pairing.label: Pair a device
pairing.hint: Scan this on the other device, or type the code in by hand.
pairing.expired: That pairing code expired. Try again.

wol.label: Wake-on-LAN
wol.enabled: Enabled on this Mac. Another device on the same network can wake it up.
wol.disabled: Turned off. A sleeping Mac won't wake for a pairing request until you enable this in System Settings.

offLan: To reach this computer from outside your home network, connect both devices to your own VPN (like Tailscale or WireGuard) or set up your router for it, then pair while connected that way. OpenPal doesn't run its own relay service.
